subdomains.name: Ferocity Subdomain (Strength)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Strength Surge with Ferocious Strike and replace the Strength domain's 3rd- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Ferocious Strike
powers.summary: Designate a melee attack as a ferocious strike; on a hit it deals additional damage equal to half cleric level, minimum +1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Might of the Gods
powers.summary: As a free action, add cleric level as an enhancement bonus to Strength for Strength checks and Strength-based skills. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Resolve Subdomain (Strength)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Might of the Gods with Bestow Resolve and replace the Strength domain's 1st- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Strength Surge
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant an enhancement bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on melee attacks, Strength-based combat maneuvers, and Strength checks and skills for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Bestow Resolve
powers.summary: Grant all allies within 20 feet temporary hit points equal to cleric level + Wisdom modifier for 1 minute. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Day Subdomain (Sun)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Nimbus of Light with Day's Resurgence and replace the Sun domain's 2nd- and 3rd-level spells.

powers.name: Sun's Blessing
powers.summary: Add cleric level to damage dealt to undead with positive-energy channeling, and undead do not add channel resistance to saves against that channel.

powers.name: Day's Resurgence
powers.summary: After 10 uninterrupted minutes, restore a willing creature as if it completed 8 hours of rest and let it retry once-per-day saves against ongoing effects, without granting additional spell preparation. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per two levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Light Subdomain (Sun)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Sun's Blessing with Blinding Flash and replace the Sun domain's 1st- and 3rd-level spells.

powers.name: Blinding Flash
powers.summary: As a standard action, emit a 20-foot flash. Creatures with fewer Hit Dice than cleric level are blinded for 1d4 rounds unless they save, and all creatures are dazzled for rounds equal to half cleric level, minimum 1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Nimbus of Light
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot daylight nimbus for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Undead within it take damage equal to cleric level each round, and lower-level darkness effects are dispelled.

subdomains.name: Exploration Subdomain (Travel)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Agile Feet with Door Sight and replace the Travel domain's 1st-, 4th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Door Sight
powers.summary: After touching a surface for 1 minute, see through it as clairvoyance for up to 10 minutes while maintaining contact and taking no other action. The surface can be up to 6 inches plus 1 inch per cleric level thick. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Dimensional Hop
powers.summary: As a move action, teleport up to a total of 10 feet per cleric level each day, spent in 5-foot increments. You can bring willing allies by spending additional distance.

subdomains.name: Trade Subdomain (Travel)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Agile Feet with Silver-Tongued Haggler and replace the Travel domain's 1st-, 5th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Silver-Tongued Haggler
powers.summary: As a free action when making a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Sense Motive check, gain a bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Dimensional Hop
powers.summary: As a move action, teleport up to a total of 10 feet per cleric level each day, spent in 5-foot increments. You can bring willing allies by spending additional distance.
